newsitem.title: USA: Regis buys two Tallahassee, Fla. salons.
newsitem.headline: Regis buys two Tallahassee, Fla. salons.

text.p: Regis Corp said Tuesday it acquired two beauty salons located in Tallahassee, Fla., which generate about $400,000 in annual sales.
They will operate within the company's Supercuts division.
Including these transactions, Regis has completed 60 acquisitions in the past 41 months, adding 1,688 salons generating annualized revenue of $240 million and system-wide sales of $481 million.
Regis operates and franchises 3,253 salons in six divisions (Regis Hairstylists, Supercuts, MasterCuts, Trade Secret, Wal-Mart and International).
